caseNameFull: J. McGuire v. Railroad Labor Board
attorneys: Mr. Donald R. Richberg for appellant.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Northern District of Illinois.

Appeal dismissed and case remanded to the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois with directions to dismiss the petition without costs to either party, per stipulation of counsel, on motion of Solicitor General Mitchell in that behalf, for appellee.
